prompt:
Summarize database sharding strategies. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use any words with more than 4 letters. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Format as an HTML unordered list (
  • ...
).
response_text:
```html
  • Split big data into smal parts.
  • Use key val to pick shard (e.g., hash).
  • Range shard by num or date (e.g., IDs 1-1000).
  • Dir shard by loc (near data to users).
  • Use key parts for even load (e.g., user ID mod 4).
  • Keep same data in one shard (no split).
  • Use proxies to route req to right shard.
  • Sync data bet shards if need (slow, hard).
  • Add new shards when old get full (scale).
  • Watch for hot spots (some shards too busy).
  • Use repl for fail safe (copy data to back).
```
